shared_elements: incised linear/curvilinear designs cut into a stone surface
closed curved forms (spirals/loops in A, curled hair and rounded vessels in B)
justification: A shows an all-over field of abstract curvilinear and spiral/concentric motifs scattered over irregular rock faces with no figures, while B shows two carefully proportioned human figures in profile facing one another, holding a vessel and a bucket, with fringed garments, patterned hair and a horizontal band of sign-like script. The only correspondence is the utterly generic fact of incised curved lines on stone; there is no shared motif, no shared figure-to-figure relationship, and opposite conventions (schematic abstraction versus detailed semi-naturalistic figuration).
